summary: Sky Quarry Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 7.01 & 8.01) announcing the entry into the production phase at its Eagle Springs Refinery in Nevada, operated by wholly owned subsidiary Foreland Refining Corporation. Repairs are complete and refinery operations are expected to commence in July 2026. The filing is a routine operational update regarding the start of production at an existing facility. No special-situation terms such as pricing, premium, board recommendation, or transaction mechanics are provided. This is a standard current report disclosing a milestone in the company's business operations, which does not constitute a special situation event.
